channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Rasheed Wallace | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Rasheed Wallace from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Joe Dumars on Rasheed Wallace
item.description:
Joe Dumars:

“The day of the trade for Rasheed Wallace. I felt we had a great shot to win.”

Joe Dumars on Rasheed Wallace, Oct 23, 2024. Source: reddit.

item.title: Jalen Duren on Rasheed Wallace
item.description:
Geoff Calkins:Jalen Duren on Rasheed Wallace:

“He was a great mentor for the bigs for the short time he was here.”

Jalen Duren on Rasheed Wallace, Jan 19, 2022. Source: Twitter @geoff_calkins.

item.title: Ben Wallace on Rasheed Wallace, Richard Hamilton, Chauncey Billups, Tayshaun Prince
item.description:
“Smart enough to draft Tayshaun Prince, smart enough to trade for Rip Hamilton, smart enough to trade for Chauncey Billups, smart enough to trade for and believe in Rasheed (Wallace). So you know, it is what it is.”

Ben Wallace on Rasheed Wallace, Richard Hamilton, Chauncey Billups, Tayshaun Prince, May 7, 2020. Source: Booth Newspapers.

item.title: Kevin Garnett on Rasheed Wallace, Tim Duncan
item.description:
Garnett told the group in New York.

“I didn't want to fail them. They took a risk on me. When I showed up to set, I was ready. It took me back to, 'OK, it's Rasheed Wallace tonight. It's Tim Duncan tonight' -- watching film. I took those same things coming in here.”

Kevin Garnett on Rasheed Wallace, Tim Duncan, Dec 13, 2019. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Marc Gasol on Rasheed Wallace, Pau Gasol
item.description:
Classic Marc Gasol on getting Finals advice from Pau Gasol:

“He was playing Boston at that time and then he played Orlando and third year he played Boston again. What could I ask him, like how to guard Rasheed Wallace?”

Marc Gasol on Rasheed Wallace, Pau Gasol, Jun 6, 2019. Source: Twitter @WolstatSun.

item.title: Bam Adebayo on Rasheed Wallace
item.description:
“We’ve worked out and just kept getting better. It’s not the first time me and Rasheed worked out. His workouts are pretty short and sweet. They're to the point.”

Bam Adebayo on Rasheed Wallace, Jun 20, 2018. Source: South Florida Sun-Sentinel.

item.title: Marcus Morris on Rasheed Wallace
item.description:
“I kind of feel like I'm getting that Rasheed Wallace treatment, just, quick trigger, quick trigger,”

Marcus Morris on Rasheed Wallace, Apr 8, 2018. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Amir Johnson on Rasheed Wallace
item.description:
Derek Bodner‏:Amir Johnson on gaining weight as a young player.

“I think Rasheed Wallace told me to drink beer once to gain weight.”

Amir Johnson on Rasheed Wallace, Sep 26, 2017. Source: Twitter @DerekBodnerNBA.

item.title: Russell Westbrook on Rasheed Wallace
item.description:
Ananth Pandian:Russell Westbrook:

“Portland was a team I watched [growing up] because Rasheed Wallace was one of my favorite players.”

Russell Westbrook on Rasheed Wallace, Dec 13, 2016. Source: Twitter @Ananth_Pandian.

item.title: Tayshaun Prince on Rasheed Wallace, Chauncey Billups
item.description:
Prince told The Undefeated.

“Every time something happens or someone has something brewing or whatever, or someone does something, we always text … They check in and say, ‘Hey what’s going on?’ to me. ‘Have you talked to anybody? … Know where you stand as far as what you are trying to do.’ Obviously, Rip, Rasheed, Ben and Chauncey at this point in their career, they were in a situation where they were trying to go to a contender or at least be in a playoff-type atmosphere, so at least when you go out there you have something to play for. They have an idea of what I am going through right now.”

Tayshaun Prince on Rasheed Wallace, Chauncey Billups, Oct 17, 2016. Source: The Undefeated.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Rasheed Wallace
item.description:
“There’s not much you’ve got to do. I had Rasheed [Wallace]. He probably was the test market for any emotional player. Rasheed was a great teammate, he was a great guy, but when he lost it, he lost it, and listen, better coaches than me coached Rasheed. … I came to the conclusion if they couldn’t stop it I’m not going to try.”

Doc Rivers on Rasheed Wallace, Jan 9, 2014. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Maurice Cheeks on Rasheed Wallace
item.description:
Kerry Eggers:Mo Cheeks on 1st-year Piston asst coach Rasheed Wallace:

“Sheed's doing very well. None of our big guys can shoot like he did, though.”

Maurice Cheeks on Rasheed Wallace, Nov 11, 2013. Source: Twitter @kerryeggers.

item.title: Joe Dumars on Rasheed Wallace
item.description:
Dave Pemberton:Dumars on hiring Rasheed:

“Bright, articulate, intelligent guy. That’s what we went out and hired him for. To bring that to the young bigs.”

Joe Dumars on Rasheed Wallace, Jul 10, 2013. Source: Twitter @drpemberton.

item.title: Mike Woodson on Rasheed Wallace
item.description:
Jared Zwerling:Woodson on Rasheed scrimmaging:

“He's not ready yet. He's just not there where we want him to be ... But he'll get there.”

Mike Woodson on Rasheed Wallace, Oct 6, 2012. Source: Twitter @JaredZwerling.

item.title: Glen Grunwald on Rasheed Wallace
item.description:
Glen Grunwald on Rasheed Wallace:

“We think be probably will sign, but nothing has been done yet.”

Glen Grunwald on Rasheed Wallace, Oct 1, 2012. Source: Twitter @ByNateTaylor.

item.title: Kendrick Perkins on Rasheed Wallace
item.description:
Kendrick Perkins:

“Well to be honest I think Stephen A. Smith just wants a little attention because I haven’t heard anything about that. I talked to Rasheed and not once has he mentioned about coming back. I think Rasheed is more of a family man now. He’s doing a lot of things with his son, his wife, his little girl and the children that he has. I asked him about it and he never mentioned it to me or any other guy, so it was kind of a surprise to us too.”

Kendrick Perkins on Rasheed Wallace, Jan 14, 2011. Source: Sports Radio Interviews.

item.title: Bill Strickland on Rasheed Wallace
item.description:
While ‘Sheed’s agent, Bill Strickland, wouldn’t completely rule it out, it doesn’t sound like Wallace is even contemplating the possibility of coming out of retirement – for the Celtics or anybody else.

“I have not talked to Danny [Ainge, the Celtics’ president] or Rasheed about that, but I think Rasheed is through,”

Bill Strickland on Rasheed Wallace, Nov 17, 2010. Source: CBSSports.com.

item.title: Danny Ainge on Rasheed Wallace
item.description:
The team announced Tuesday night that they waived him after coming to a mutual agreement and that Wallace will retire.

“We would like to thank Rasheed for everything that he did for this team and organization last season,”

Danny Ainge on Rasheed Wallace, Aug 11, 2010. Source: WEEI.com.
